reason: ₹21,999 is about two months of everything we earn, and ₹1,999 every month for a year is a fifth of our household money. We wash by hand and it works; I cannot put that much into a machine when seed, school fees and the doctor come first.
objection: It costs too much for a family like mine, and I am not sure a cold wash will get the mud and sweat out of farm clothes. I would still be scrubbing them by hand after paying all that.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost under ₹10,000, or the monthly payment was around ₹500, and I saw a neighbour's muddy field clothes come out clean from it.
